# M-5 — Detection results

**Milestone:** M-5 (SPEC §12) · **Seeds:** [0] · **Generated by** `fidnn report`

> ⚠️ **Not yet reportable.** SPEC §9.5 (C4) requires ≥ 5 seeds per configuration; these tables cover 1 ([0]).

Detection quality is read together with the overhead figures in [`docs/M0_throughput.md`](M0_throughput.md)
— C5 makes them one result, not two.
